user.title: WHES ECOS Hub
user.description: Enter the AccessKey and AccessKeySecret you received from WHES. These are the Open API credentials, not your ECOS app login.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ECOS Hub API. Check the region and your network.
error.invalid_auth: The API rejected the signature. Check the AccessKey and AccessKeySecret.
error.no_devices: No devices are bound to these credentials.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: The device uploads a new sample about every 10 seconds. Polling faster than that just re-fetches the same reading.

set_control_mode.name: Set control mode
set_control_mode.description: Apply a VPP control mode to the inverter. Anything you leave blank falls back to the corresponding number entity.

bat_power.name: Battery power
bat_power.description: NEGATIVE charges the battery, POSITIVE discharges it. Note this is the opposite of the battery power sensor.

bat_cap_min.name: Minimum battery level
bat_cap_min.description: The inverter will not discharge below this level.

max_feedin_limit.name: Maximum feed-in limit
max_feedin_limit.description: Percentage of rated grid power allowed to be exported.

ppv_limit.name: PV power limit
ppv_limit.description: Caps solar production while the mode is active.

bat_power_inv_limit.name: Inverter power limit
bat_power_inv_limit.description: Battery power reference limit for the inverter setpoint modes.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: The inverter reverts to normal operation after this many seconds. Acts as a dead-man's switch.
